title: 35 · eleventh_rudra · The Eleventh Rudra
lines: n
One telling says Hanuman is Shiva himself.
n
Look at how he prays, and you may believe it.
n
Vishnu was to be born on earth as Rama.
n
And Shiva said:
Then I am coming too.
"Then I am coming too.
Not as a king. As his servant.
Not as a king. As his servant."
n
The god other gods bow to
asked for the lowest place in the story.
n
His power was carried by the wind,
to a mother praying on a mountain.
n
The child was born with the strength of a storm,
and no memory of who he was.
n
He leapt oceans. He lifted mountains.
And every time, he said the same thing.
n
It is not me. It is Rama's name.
"It is not me. It is Rama's name."
n
Shiva sits on Kailash, repeating one name.
Hanuman sits at Rama's feet, repeating one name.
n
It is the same name.
n
The greatest power is choosing to serve. That is sadhana.
n
